title: The Ninth Pillar: Choosing Righteous Companions and Avoiding Bad Company

text_simplified: Paying constant attention to children's companions and friends is among the greatest pillars of tarbiyah, for a friend pulls (الصاحب ساحب) and inevitably influences his companion. The Prophet ﷺ gave the example of the righteous companion as a carrier of musk from whom you obtain good or a pleasant scent, and the example of a bad companion as a blower of the bellows who may burn your clothes or from whom you find a foul smell.
